Look before you leap"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Open the **online preview** — the same render kernel as the plugin, no install needed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Override per-profile via `cordis.patch.yml`; defaults live in the plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `scale` | `1` | Whale size, 0.72–1.25 |

If public slots or required services are missing in your Harness build, the plugin logs"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" a clear error and stops safely."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 🌊 Behavior"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- The whale outline is sampled directly from the `favicon.svg` path in this repo — WebGL2 renders ≈1"},{"id":"p28s2","text":",750 regular grid points.
- ~11 s vertical breathing, a ~29 s slow turn, plus tail-fin motion and ge"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ntle buoyancy; the pointer adds ~6° parallax and a positional offset.
- Inside the whale, particles "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"within ~200 px of the pointer form a continuous liquid vortex (motion-only feedback, no brightness o"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"r size change); after the pointer leaves they settle back softly in ~800 ms. The base dot matrix is "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"never modified.
- Follows the Harness appearance setting (light / dark / system): dark keeps white→i"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ce-blue particles over a deepened pool, light switches to high-contrast ink `#050b14` over a brighte"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"ned pool, with matching semantic tokens, mist layers and background.
- Both themes expose the full-s"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"creen base layer behind the app frame; sidebar, inputs, conversation content and settings windows ke"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ep their own surfaces — no full-screen veil washing out the dots. The reading scrim covers the measu"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"red text blocks only, not the whole column, so the ink keeps its near-black (light) / white (dark) v"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"alue in every margin no glyph touches.
- Full brightness with no session open; ~78 % once a session "},{"id":"p28s13","text":"opens; at least 50 % while typing or a task runs (still honors a stronger `activeDimming`), ~600 ms "},{"id":"p28s14","text":"transitions.
- Pauses when the page is hidden; completely still under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduc"},{"id":"p28s15","text":"e`.
- DPR capped at 1.5; `auto` steps down high → medium → low after sustained frame drops.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 🧩 Architecture & ecosystem"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"This is one of the first third-party client plugins for DeepSeek Harness. It participates in the lif"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ecycle through the public `shell.overlay` slot: the wallpaper canvas is prepended beneath the app fr"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ame and never blocks Harness controls."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Zero runtime dependencies; three devDependencies (esbuild, typescript, schemastery). `lib/` and `pre"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"view.js` are build artifacts produced by `pnpm build`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## 🔭 Compatibility"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Built against the browser web UI of `@deepseek-ai/dsh`, verified up to `0.1.6-alpha.1`. The Harness "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"is in dev-preview, so a release can move the DOM hooks this plugin leans on (it happened twice: the "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"shell frame lost `data-details-collapsed` in 0.1.5, and the conversation slot was renamed to `main.c"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"st `data-details-collapsed` in 0.1.5, and the conversation slot was renamed to `main.conversation`)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Three guards exist for that, and none of them require reading this file first:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- `npm run compat` checks the *installed* Harness for every hook the plugin uses and names what a mi"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ssing one would break. Run it after upgrading the Harness, before restarting the GUI.
- `window.__ha"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"rnessWhale.check()` (and `document.documentElement.dataset.hwwStatus`) reports the live state: which"},{"id":"p36s4","text":" surfaces are transparent, how much wallpaper survives at five sample points, and `failed` if the pl"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"ugin could not mount at all.
- If a hook moved, the whale simply stops being visible — the shell is "},{"id":"p36s6","text":"left exactly as it was, and docs/compatibility.md lists each hook, its Harness range, and the sympto"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"m. `release/*.tgz` holds every previous build for a one-command rollback."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Every hook that turns out to be stale is now a build-time failure: `npm run check` refuses to ship a"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" bundle whose selectors or ink constants drifted."}],"truncated":true}
